serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policeman: Hmph! I can’t believe Serge told us to come here! Doesn’t he know it’s dangerous?!
Policewoman: Someone needs to do it. {{wi}}At least from time to time.
Policeman: I get it, but why us?! Couldn’t he send some new blood?
Policewoman: Would you want your first patrol to be here?
Policeman: I wouldn’t ever want to go here! This cursed no-go zone! 
Policewoman: We are still outside of it, we didn’t even go through the wall.
Policewoman: Also, do not mention you-know-what when there are people around us. It doesn’t exist, remember? 
Policeman: Yeah, yeah, I know. There’s no such thing as a no-go zone. The city is safe. Crime is going down. Yada yada yada.
Policewoman: You mentioned it again…
#Policeman.Face.lookateachother
Policeman: What? No-go zone?
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policewoman: …
Policewoman: Now you know why Serg sent us here, you just can’t keep your mouth shut. This guy there heard us for sure.
Policeman: Ugh!
Policeman: Hey you! What are you doing here!
Shit! He spoke to me!
You: N-Nothing much… Just going around on a walk.
Policeman: On a walk? Here?
You: Yeah, is there a problem?
Policeman: Do you know where we are? We are near no-go zo- I mean, uh…{{wi}} We are near you-know-what.
I can use the conversation I eavesdropped just a moment ago.
You: What? Sorry, I don’t know what you mean.
Policeman: No-go zone, dammit! That super dangerous place that even policemen don’t enter if they can avoid it.
You: Huh? Isn’t it just a conspiracy theory or something?
Policeman: Grrrr! 
Policewoman: Just leave him alone, weren’t you scared to be here? The faster we leave, the better.
Policeman: I-I wasn’t scared! I just feel uneasy!
Policewoman: Isn’t that the same thing?
Policeman: Whatever! 
Policeman: You! Get out of my sight before I change my mind!
You: Sure thing!
